# Requirements Quality Checklist: HR & Attendance (Milestone M2a)

**Purpose**: Validate requirement completeness, clarity, testability, and architectural guardrails for Milestone M2a before task execution  
**Created**: 2026-10-11  
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) | [plan.md](../plan.md)  

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by `/speckit-checklist` as a reviewer-owned requirements-quality artifact ("unit tests for English").  
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the requirement-quality criterion is reviewed and satisfied in the specification. It does NOT mean code implementation is complete.

---

## 1. Zero TypeScript Enums & Shared Types Contracts

- [x] CHK001 Are all domain value sets (`DEPARTMENTS`, `USER_STATUSES`, `ATTENDANCE_STATUSES`) defined exclusively as `as const` arrays and derived union types in `@alfahd/types`?
- [x] CHK002 Is the TypeScript `enum` keyword strictly forbidden across the monorepo with an automated gate (ESLint / AST grep)?
- [x] CHK003 Are Drizzle `pgEnum` definitions in `apps/api` specified to directly consume the `@alfahd/types` `as const` arrays without duplicated string arrays?

## 2. Geofencing & Distance Computation

- [x] CHK004 Is the Haversine distance algorithm specified as a pure, unit-tested function?
- [x] CHK005 Is distance computation strictly performed server-side from raw device coordinates, ignoring any client-reported distance?
- [x] CHK006 Are exact distance boundary conditions quantified in tests (0m, 149m accepted, 150m accepted, 151m rejected)?
- [x] CHK007 Does the check-in rejection response specify returning the measured distance in error details alongside the human-readable message?

## 3. Timezone, Lateness & Calendar Day Boundaries

- [x] CHK008 Is the calendar day boundary (`work_date`) evaluated strictly in `Africa/Cairo` with Egypt Daylight Saving Time (DST) support?
- [x] CHK009 Is `ATTENDANCE_CUTOFF_TIME` (09:00 default) evaluated against local Cairo wall-clock time rather than a fixed UTC offset?
- [x] CHK010 Are client-submitted timestamps completely ignored in favor of an injectable server `ClockService`?
- [x] CHK011 Is the one-check-in-per-day rule backed by a database unique constraint `UNIQUE (user_id, work_date)`?
- [x] CHK012 Does the spec explicitly state that absent days are represented by the absence of records, prohibiting synthetic "ABSENT" database rows?

## 4. Object Storage & File Security

- [x] CHK013 Is file validation specified to verify magic bytes for JPEG (`FF D8 FF`) and PNG (`89 50 4E 47`) buffers rather than trusting client `Content-Type`?
- [x] CHK014 Is the maximum file size bounded at 5 MB prior to transmitting bytes to Cloudinary?
- [x] CHK015 Is rollback compensation specified to immediately delete the uploaded Cloudinary asset if the subsequent database update fails?
- [x] CHK016 Is replacement cleanup specified to delete the previous Cloudinary asset immediately upon saving the new photo key?
- [x] CHK017 Is `FakeStorageService` specified for unit and E2E test suites, guaranteeing zero external network requests during test runs?

## 5. Employee Lifecycle & Session Revocation

- [x] CHK018 Does updating employee status to `INACTIVE` require a mandatory justification reason and immediately revoke all active Redis refresh tokens (`rt:{userId}:*`)?
- [x] CHK019 Does updating employee status to `ON_LEAVE` preserve existing sessions while making the technician ineligible for work assignment?
- [x] CHK020 Is `assigned_warehouse_id` strictly enforced as mandatory for users with role `TECHNICIAN`?

## 6. Asynchronous Report Pipeline

- [x] CHK021 Does `GET /attendance/report` enqueue a BullMQ job and return 202 Accepted with `{ jobId }` without blocking the HTTP request thread?
- [x] CHK022 Is the report date range bounded to a maximum of 12 months (366 days), rejecting wider intervals with 400 Bad Request (`DATE_RANGE_EXCEEDS_MAXIMUM`)?
- [x] CHK023 Does the report worker format Arabic text, proper column headers, and working hours calculation in `exceljs`?
- [x] CHK024 Is `GET /jobs/:id` specified to return job status (`QUEUED | RUNNING | COMPLETED | FAILED`) and Cloudinary download URL upon completion?

---

## Notes

- All 24 checklist items validate the requirements quality, boundary completeness, and security guardrails of Milestone M2a.
- All items align with `PLAN.md` §6, §7d, §9 (M2a), §10 and the project constitution.
